header_summary:
A novel protocol has been proposed to enable soft-agreement in the Bitcoin mempool prior to block discovery, leveraging group-based consensus inspired by the Snowball protocol to accelerate block propagation and improve network efficiency. For comprehensive technical specifications, refer to the original paper at [https://beige-worrying-unicorn-969.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/bafybeigsbdid4znwtmoqh55yid2etxkujci33dzqt3ia6bt5vwsnllfqym](https://beige-worrying-unicorn-969.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/bafybeigsbdid4znwtmoqh55yid2etxkujci33dzqt3ia6bt5vwsnllfqym) and discussion at [DelvingBitcoin](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/snowball-to-snowstorm/3014).

A comparative analysis of Alice/Bob/Carol channel implementations utilizing APO+CTV, CSFS+CTV ladder, and a TEMPLATEHASH+CSFS+INTERNALKEY configuration demonstrates significant improvements in script simplicity, witness size, and transaction efficiency. The TEMPLATEHASH method, highlighted in recent testing and detailed by Aaron Recompilé, achieves a minimal 10-byte update leaf, a constant 143-byte witness, and streamlined scripting, as seen in the [source code](https://github.com/aaron-recompile/btcaaron/blob/5ef4cb3dff5d51d812ff55a134d48c0e269323e7/btcaaron/templatehash.py) and analysis at [DelvingBitcoin](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/eltoo-state-chain-on-signet-third-time-templatehash-csfs-internalkey/3012).

The Bitcoin developer mailing list archive interface has been enhanced with a year-based navigation system, allowing users to efficiently browse threads by year and month dating back to 2011. The homepage now features a “Recently active” list and clearer labels, significantly improving accessibility and user experience in response to community feedback ([DelvingBitcoin](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/we-made-the-bitcoin-dev-mailing-list-readable-15-years-24-699-messages/2985/3)).

recent_posts.title: Snowball to Snowstorm
recent_posts.summary: - A new protocol supports soft-agreement in the Bitcoin mempool, improving block propagation speed.  - The system uses batch consensus among participants, inspired by Snowball and other consensus protocols.  - Enhanced coordination in transaction selection results in streamlined block formation and dissemination.

recent_posts.title: Eltoo state chain on signet, third time: TEMPLATEHASH + CSFS + INTERNALKEY
recent_posts.summary: - Three different implementations were compared: APO+CTV, CSFS+CTV ladder, and TEMPLATEHASH+CSFS+INTERNALKEY.  - Templatehash significantly reduced witness size and script complexity, enabling more flexible and efficient updates.  - The test showcased state replacement, revealing each method’s unique technological characteristics and effectiveness.

recent_posts.title: We made the bitcoin-dev mailing list readable: 15 years, 24,699 messages
recent_posts.summary: - The archive features a "Years" section listing each year since 2011, plus thread counts.  - Each year page allows month-based navigation and includes anchor links for quick access.  - The main entry was renamed and improved for clarity, with a homepage list of recent messages.

active_posts.title: Stats on compact block reconstructions
active_posts.summary:
- The study analyzes compact block reconstruction efficiency by examining transaction sources and node configurations.
- Configuration changes and heightened mempool activity influenced block reconstruction rates and network congestion effects.
- Enabling full-RBF and adjusting policies may improve reconstruction efficiency and reduce median processing times.

active_posts.title: Public key recovery for EC leaves in P2MR (BIP-360)
active_posts.summary: - The proposal enables public key recovery from signatures, reducing witness size in Pay-to-Merkle-root structures.  - Security is maintained by linking signature challenges to the Merkle root hash, avoiding related-key attacks.  - The approach requires changes to witness validation, streamlining the structure and updating nonce derivation for safety.

active_posts.title: P2share: how to turn any network (or testnet!) into a bitcoin miner
active_posts.summary: - The p2share network distributes block rewards by randomly awarding the entire bitcoin reward to a single shareholder.  - Shares are transferable, and their ownership determines the likelihood of receiving future mining rewards.  - This model promotes fairness, efficiency, and decentralization while presenting questions about miner incentives and network impact.

today_in_history_posts.title: Bitcoin-NG whitepaper.
today_in_history_posts.summary: - There is a vulnerability involving double spends in microblocks with no punishment for offenders.  - Increasing wait times beyond network propagation delay could help mitigate the double spending risk.  - The email highlights challenges in analyzing game theory and attacker incentives for this protocol issue.

today_in_history_posts.title: Lightning, the death of BIP62, and Segregated Witness
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Anchor malleability was identified as an issue, and BIP62 would not be deployed.  - The chosen solution was to rely on Segregated Witness to fix all malleability problems.  - Ignoring malleability simplifies the code, but future support may be challenging to implement.

today_in_history_posts.title: Libbitcoin for Core people
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Libbitcoin achieves significantly faster Initial Block Download by using event-based, asynchronous processing and optimized database management.  - Its design enables parallel transaction validation with configurable sequencing, efficient indexing, and straightforward blockchain reorganization.  - Future improvements include dynamic peer selection, expanded fee handling, and addressing the absence of advanced DoS protection.
